rules.description: Stories and posts on the start page. Posts, reels and profiles you open yourself, search and messages are left alone.
rules.notes: Instagram's class names are generated and change with every release. The one lasting hook is the stories row, data-pagelet="story_tray". The first selector takes the column around it, which also holds the feed tabs and the posts. The second is the fallback for a start page without stories: the element two levels above the posts, which holds the posts and the loading marker after them.
